description: darwin-modules/apps/kanata/{default.nix,render.nix}. Drop platform param and modules/kanata/. Options are the only flag list + defaults (no pass-through, no duplicated pedal defaults); render.nix private, receives cfg whole. Flag rules: stockToggle=>mediaKeys as module assertions; fnDndHack+mediaKeys emits a warning. macOS side effects stay in default.nix. Build-time runCommand pkgs.master.kanata --check on the rendered .kbd (matches brew 1.12.0). Karabiner out of scope.
title: Collapse kanata into one darwin module + build-time --check
